name: Notions: First Movement
source:
In the heart of Boston, college student Arthur feels lost and aimless. When he finds what seems to be a suicide note, though, his life becomes entwined with that of a total stranger.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/notions.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
在波士顿市中心，大学生亚瑟感到迷茫，人生漫无目的。然而，当他发现一封疑似遗书的信件后，他的命运便与一名素不相识的人交织在一起。

[引自[url=http://renai.us/game/notions.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
